value.name: reviews corrected filing against notes
value.description: Asha compares Devin's corrected filing with her Monday trial notes and checks the timestamps against her own recorded call time.
evidence: In the hospital lot, Asha left the engine off and the form on the passenger seat and pulled the briefcase up onto her knees.

She opened it on the slant of her lap and laid Devin's corrected filing flat against the lid, then dug under it for the legal pad with her Monday trial notes and set the two pages side by side along the line where the timestamps ran.

She read the header on the corrected document twice, found the minute the intake stamp had been printed in the footer, and matched both against the margin where she had written the time she'd called the caseworker to the stand.

value.name: realizes the numbers nearly match
value.description: Asha sees that the timestamps are close enough to matter and pauses, staring at the pages in silence.
evidence: The numbers were close enough that she stopped moving her thumb across the page and just looked at them, the parking lot quiet around the car, the voicemail she had already played twice still sitting open on the phone in the cup holder.

value.name: closes briefcase on evidence
value.description: Asha shuts the briefcase over the documents without looking again, treating the discovery as weighty.
evidence: Asha closed the briefcase over both pages without looking down at them again.
The latch caught on the second try, and she lifted the case off her lap onto the passenger seat beside the folded form, where it sat heavier than it had on the way in.

value.name: hides voicemail in coat pocket
value.description: Asha puts her phone away without checking it, leaving the voicemail from Whitfield and Devin's number untouched.
evidence: She slid the phone out of the cup holder and into her coat pocket without thumbing it open, the voicemail still queued under Whitfield's name, Devin's number still untouched two screens down.

value.name: starts car and leaves lot
value.description: Asha starts the engine and prepares to back out of the hospital lot, resisting another look at the notes.
evidence: She turned the key, and the engine came up under her hands;
she did not let herself look at the numbers in the margin of the legal pad one more time before she put the car in reverse
